name: What is the typical cost range for an open-floor-plan conversion in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for an open-floor-plan conversion in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an open-floor-plan conversion in Los Angeles can vary significantly based on scope. Factors include the number of walls to be removed, whether they are load-bearing, the need for structural reinforcements, and any associated finishes like new flooring, electrical, or plumbing. A basic conversion might start from $25,000, but complex projects involving structural engineering and high-end finishes can exceed $100,000. A detailed assessment is needed for an accurate quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs in Los Angeles vary widely, from $25,000 for basic projects to over $100,000 for complex ones, depending on structural work and finishes.
